City of Chicago
                                                                    O2022-2462
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/20/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Martin (47)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-H at 1753 W Cornelia
                              Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


         SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changing all ofthe RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in the area bounded by
       West Cornelia Avenue; a line 75 feet east of and parallel to North Ravenswood
       Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to West Cornelia Avenue;
       and a line 50 feet east of and parallel to North Ravenswood Avenue
to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

       SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and publication.


Common Address:               1753 West Cornelia Avenue




                                                                         MATTHEW MARTIN
                                                                         Alderman, 47th Ward
